passage: Researchers testing a new malaria vaccine first gave it to a small group of adults to check its safety. Once no serious side effects appeared, they expanded the trial to several hundred volunteers to determine the best dose. ______ they launched a study with thousands of children across four countries to measure how well the vaccine prevented disease.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
steps: The text lists stages in order: safety, dose, then a large effectiveness study.
“Instead” means replacing, “Meanwhile” means at the same time, and “Conversely” means the opposite.
key: Sequences of stages call for time-order transitions.
